capabilities: Speak a daily summary of the vault
Show project progress and idle projects
extras: Desktop only. No network, telemetry, or accounts; all data is computed locally. File explorer icons rely on an undocumented Obsidian API and may break after updates.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in home page that gathers what needs attention today—projects, overdue tasks, and deadlines—into one spoken overview.

relations.evidence: only if the Claudian (by YishenTu) plugin is installed

summary: Home page in a sci-fi HUD style that shows and speaks a daily briefing: where you left off, idle projects, overdue tasks, and deadlines.
